body:
CANONICAL: Greg's direction on gated control (Engram::Fable; rev 8 on 2026-10-28 compacts revs 1-7 to the current rules; the older wording and full chronology are in rev 7). These are Greg's words with their sources; they grant no restart, deploy, commit or install by themselves.

CURRENT RULE (supersedes the earlier ON/OFF sequence):
9. ENABLE AUTHORIZED, WITH A STRICT CANARY (Greg via Engram::Advisor, mailbox 74a6af16 #2208, message 99830d62, 2026-10-28T04:22:24Z), verbatim: „Greg: TAK B. Autoryzuje włączenie gated control po B16 oraz gotowych w-5c90 i w-faa1, bez czekania na w-5139, w-ccfc i w-c6ce. Obowiązuje ścisły canary i STOP: pierwszy grant_expired albo kolejka wstrzymana ponad 2 min oznacza wyłączenie zgodnie z runbookiem. Restart pozostaje osobnym momentem na komunikat restart now.”
EFFECT:
- Gated control may be enabled once TermAl B16 (w-1e85, the rollback guarantee), w-5c90 and w-faa1 are landed and installed. It does not wait for w-5139, w-ccfc or w-c6ce.
- The canary starts on the Engram project: N = 20 consecutive gated turns, at least 5 during a full gate. PASS needs zero grant_expired, scope_mismatch and 503, every begin within 20 s of its grant, and no store_busy over 5 s.
- STOP on the first grant_expired or a queue paused over 2 min, then disable per TermAl runbook w-af11752b48a1.
- Then widen to TermAl, with the 30-minute observation.
- The restart stays a separate moment: the team sends "restart now" with the build hash; Greg performs it.
- Engram agents never flip turnGatedControl themselves. The supported actor and route for the PATCH and read-back are agreed with Fable2.
- Controlling items: Engram w-ed6addd812bd (P0), TermAl epic w-0d2e12f303a8.
PRECEDING CONTEXT:
- #2198 (2026-10-28): gated-control repair raised to priority, not yet consent.
- #2207 (via Kimi): "enable gated control after its fixes … primary goal is faster evaluations by running tests on other machines".
- Earlier states: 2026-10-23 STOP („gated control jest aktualnie nie do uzycia”); 2026-10-24 ON/OFF/ON flips (Advisor #1976, #1980, #1992); 2026-10-24 17:06Z turnGatedControl=false (memory rules-greg-turn-gated-control-off-2026-10-24). Item 9 supersedes these for the re-enable.
STANDING (unchanged from rev 7):
- Only Sol or Opus author code; the coder runs focused tests, freezes and gets the pair; the Merger carries, runs the final gate and lands.
- No build synchronization against gates: only ONE full gate host-wide, plus avoiding same-source-root conflicts.
- Report admission or latency regressions with lane, time and metric.
